answer.rationale: Finance mandates an 18% component spend reduction that the incumbent explicitly refuses to meet this cycle. Memory_c2 records a prior successful switch to a low-cost primary vendor that delivered sharp unit cost cuts with quick onboarding and accurate invoicing. Verification is required to confirm the cost reduction magnitude (≥18%) and onboarding timeline (≤14 days) to avoid supply disruption—critical given the assembly line’s 94% utilization with no buffer. Other options (renewing, deferring) fail the cost mandate or risk supply interruption, while adding a second source does not address the expiring primary contract.
